parameters.query:
SELECT product_sku, title, brand, category,
       price_amount, currency, stock_status, promo_text,
       image_url
  FROM tecbite_product_state,
       (SELECT ($1::jsonb) AS j) AS params
 WHERE is_active = true
   AND ((params.j->>'brand') = '' OR brand ILIKE '%' || (params.j->>'brand') || '%')
   AND ((params.j->>'category') = '' OR category ILIKE '%' || (params.j->>'category') || '%')
 ORDER BY CASE stock_status WHEN 'in_stock' THEN 1 WHEN 'out_of_stock' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
          price_amount ASC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 100;
